lines_of_business: All lines of business unless noted in Program Exceptions
Medicare Advantage: LCD L33930 Facet Joint Interventions for Pain Management reviewed
sections_in_order: Position Statement (general criteria; diagnostic; therapeutic; ultrasound)
Billing/Coding Information (CPT, ICD-10, LOINC documentation table)
criteria_location: Position Statement, pp.1-2 of 10. Three blocks: a general criteria block applying to all injections, a diagnostic block and a therapeutic block. Pain assessment requirement sits in an asterisked footnote under the general block. Reimbursement Information says only 'Refer to POSITION STATEMENT'. Remaining pages are references.

logic.top_level: all: general criteria (all of 5) AND either the diagnostic block or the therapeutic block, each an all-of
logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Inline negatives inside criteria ('Absence of nonfacet pathology ... fracture, infection, significant spinal deformity or tumor'; 'No radiculopathy or neurogenic claudication (except for radiculopathy caused by facet joint synovial cyst)'). Ultrasound guidance is a separate investigational sentence.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Explicit. Diagnostic: initial, OR a second confirmatory injection at the same level 'a minimum of 2 weeks after', max 2 diagnostic procedures per region per rolling 12 months. Therapeutic: requires 80% relief from the diagnostic injection, then subsequent therapeutic injections need 50% relief for 3 months OR 50% functional improvement; max 4 therapeutic procedures per region per rolling 12 months.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Pain of ≥ 6 on a scale of 0 to 10, OR functional deficit, AND*
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: An OR inside a bullet that ends in AND; with the asterisk this has three connectors in one line.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: An initial diagnostic injection, when criteria outlined above are met, OR a second diagnostic injection at the same level (confirmatory) to establish validity of the initial diagnostic injection, performed a minimum of 2 weeks after the initial diagnostic injection, AND
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: The OR sits mid-sentence: initial OR confirmatory; the 'when criteria above are met' qualifier attaches only to the first alternative, as written.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Subsequent therapeutic injections at the same anatomic site result in at least 50% pain relief for at least three (3) months from the prior therapeutic injection, OR at least 50% improvement in the ability to perform previously painful movements and ADLs as compared to baseline measurement, AND
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: For a first therapeutic injection there is no 'subsequent'/'prior therapeutic injection'; the criterion is vacuous or unmet, undefined which.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Chronic neck or back pain suggestive of facet joint origin: predominantly axial, and/or aggravated by extension, rotation or lateral bending of the spine, and not associated with neurological deficits
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'and/or' makes axial pain optional if aggravated by movement; 'suggestive of' is judgment.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Diagnostic injection provided at least 80% pain relief (with the duration of relief being consistent with the agent used)
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Grammar broken (provided at least 80% relief); applies to prior diagnostic result, not the current request.

extraction_hazards: Asterisk footnote ('AND*' ... '*Pain assessment must be...') carries a criterion and is separated from its bullet.
The ICD-10 table lists 'M25.511, 512' style compressed ranges and a shoulder pain row; some rows lack spaces ('M25.531,532').
Position statement spans a page break right before 'BILLING/CODING INFORMATION', where the ultrasound sentence is the last line.
CPT descriptors for 0213T-0218T are wrapped with '(investigational)' appended on the last line only.
The LOINC documentation table repeats a six-month narrative in every row.
Navigation bar line after the disclaimer.
interesting_structures: Three-block shape: shared general criteria, then diagnostic versus therapeutic with separate frequency caps.
Two-step clinical logic: therapeutic injections require a documented prior diagnostic response of 80%, then 50% relief for 3 months.
Rolling-12-month counters per spinal region, for two different procedure classes.
Pain assessment at baseline and after each injection: the chart must contain a series, not a single note.
Covers both intra-articular injections and medial branch blocks with one set of criteria; the denervation sibling policy is separate (02-61000-34).

fit_to_tree.scale: 1 = all/any/not expresses it cleanly ... 5 = needs new constructs or human judgment
fit_to_tree.why: Shape is all-of with a few inline ORs and fits the tree. Strain comes from stateful history (prior injection count and relief percentages over rolling windows), diagnostic versus therapeutic mode selection (which the CPT code cannot tell), and subjective terms.
